plants.append: Comment by Amara Okafor: Paused on purpose until the January planning. We agreed at the roadmap review to pick localisation up after the winter timetable ships; nothing to do here until then.

plants.author: Dara Nikolaidis
plants.text: Phone wallet payments are failing on Android for everyone since this morning's release. SYN-87 is marked done but customers can't pay with a wallet at all.

about: A stall paused on purpose beside a done story chat says is broken.
